d:
爱莎贝儿-148CM-L 粉肤 RAD040 清野柠檬Seino Lemon-羞涩的雏菊
羞涩的雏菊蜷在晨光里，花瓣半掩，轻轻发抖。
她不敢抬头，只用细不可闻的声音说：“……别、别看我……”
脸红得像熟透的果实，却又忍不住微微绽开一点，露出一小片湿润的花心。
颤颤地，像在无声乞求被温柔触碰。
胸型：148CM-L 粉肤

Elsa Babe-148CM-L Pink RAD040 Seino Lemon-Shy Daisy
A shy daisy curls up in the morning light, its petals half-closed, trembling gently.
She dares not look up, only whispering, "...Don't, don't look at me..." Her face is as red as a ripe fruit, yet she can't help but slightly open, revealing a small patch of moist pistil.
Trembling, as if silently begging for a gentle touch.
Body type: 148CM-L with Pink skin tone.
